Strong agreement on electrophysiological findings (C8-C11). Peer review also includes C20-C21 on temporal precedence.

Agreement on linear filter analysis (C12-C19) and gain analysis (C24-C26). OpenEval finds the computational analysis methodologically sound; peer reviewers emphasize the 'higher resolution DN characterization' and accept the distinct functional profiles as well-supported.

Partial overlap on gain analysis (C24-C26). OpenEval notes the analysis would benefit from quantitative slope comparisons; peer reviewers accept these findings as part of the broader functional specialization evidence without raising concerns.

Strong agreement on bilateral recording findings (C27-C32). OpenEval notes the linear relationship is well-characterized; peer reviewers specifically highlight these 'especially impressive' dual recordings showing ipsilateral excitation and contralateral inhibition as key technical achievements.
